name: Red Moon
rule: Red light is removed from all light.

name: Short Night
rule: Gems can be struck at most twice.

name: Drift
rule: The Aperture moves one edge cell clockwise after each cast.

name: Penumbra
rule: Half the board is dark: light loses 2 Intensity crossing it.

name: Overcast
rule: Hand size 4; place at most 2 gems per cast.

name: Totality
rule: The Lantern shines at Intensity 1; only added light counts.

name: Glass Tax
rule: Every gem on the board costs 2 Lux per cast.

name: Inversion
rule: Light changes to its opposite colour crossing the middle column.

name: Tremor
rule: Before each cast one placed gem turns a step (shown in the preview).

name: Corona
rule: Only white Dawn light scores, but it scores double.
